analyst.summary: NHPC's FY26 profit growth (consolidated PAT +24.6% to Rs 4,220 cr, Q4 up ~68-71%) looks strong on the surface but leaned heavily on other income and a tax reversal rather than core generation economics, and part of FY26 revenue is a provisional tariff estimate awaiting final CERC approval on two newly-commissioned large hydro projects. Return ratios remain modest (ROE ~10%, ROCE ~7%) for a stock trading around 21x earnings, and while the company has a genuinely large, funded capacity-doubling pipeline under construction, that is a multi-year execution story in a segment (Himalayan/Northeast hydro) with a long history of delays - not a reason to pay a premium multiple today. We rate this a Sell, consistent with the quantitative score.
